description:
Workflow used for the Ecology tutorial devoted to use yolo model on SEANOE marine data

## Associated Tutorial

This workflows is part of the tutorial [Object detection with YOLO](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/topics/ecology/tutorials/yolo_predict_deepsea/tutorial.html), available in the [GTN](https://training.galaxyproject.org)

## Features

* Includes [Galaxy Workflow Tests](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/faqs/gtn/workflow_run_test.html)
* Includes a [Galaxy Workflow Report](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/faqs/galaxy/workflows_report_view.html)
